name: com.myradostudio/altegio
title: Altegio online booking (unofficial)
description: Unofficial server for Altegio online booking: services, team members, free slots, bookings.

environmentVariables.name: ALTEGIO_PARTNER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Partner token from the Altegio developer account (Account settings, Account details).

environmentVariables.name: ALTEGIO_LOCATION_ID
environmentVariables.description: Numeric id of the location to work with. When set, the tools accept no other location.

environmentVariables.name: ALTEGIO_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Origin of the Altegio API. Change it only if Altegio gave you a different host.

environmentVariables.name: ALTEGIO_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to register the write tools (create and cancel bookings, send SMS confirmation codes). Off by default.
